data_facts_with_para.paragraph: China’s BYD enjoyed a year-end surge to push total sales to 4.25 million passenger cars last year, narrowing its gap with Tesla as the two vie for the crown of top-selling electric-vehicle maker of 2024.

facts.fact_content: Total sales of 4.25 million passenger cars last year.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: BYD sold 509,440 plug-in hybrid and pure-electric passenger vehicles in December, the company said Wednesday. The figure includes 207,734 EVs, taking the annual tally of battery-powered car sales to 1.76 million. Overall annual sales increased 41% year-on-year.

facts.fact_content: BYD sold 509,440 plug-in hybrid and pure-electric passenger vehicles in December.
Annual tally of battery-powered car sales is 1.76 million.
